After the unbonding wait, `withdraw_unbonded_stake` returns only `token_unbonding_amount` (0) and closes the PDA. The validator's entire token stake — at the floor, 1,000,000 PARALOOM — stays in the shared `stake_token_vault` with no account referencing it: permanently locked, returnable by no instruct

results.title: [BOUNTY] Medium: Co-sign round demands unanimity of all Valid voters; one declining voter vetoes settlement the on-chain 2/3-stake quorum would accept
results.body_snippet: ## Summary The off-chain co-sign round demands **unanimity of every Valid voter** (`threshold = quorum_wallets.len()`), while the on-chain program only needs a 2/3 stake-weighted supermajority. One registered validator can therefore vote Valid (free, automatic) and then decline every co-sign request — vetoing a settlement its own vote approved, even when the remaining signers already clear the on-chain threshold. Declining is silent: no failure is recorded, no reputation penalty, no equivocation

results.body_snippet: ## Summary Any registered validator can exhaust the per-spend co-sign budget of a victim's settlement by sending co-sign requests under the **real, public** bridge authority. The handler never checks that the requester *is* the authority, so 4 requests from any peer burn the whole budget (`MAX_COSIGNS_PER_SETTLEMENT = 4`) and the legitimate leader's request is then declined.
